items.reason: Both D2C7-IT and 2141-V11 are investigational candidates (experimental_combination) and are already recorded as agents. The only non-candidate antitumour therapy in the arm is the standard RT given after the CED infusions ("participants will start standard radiation therapy (RT)"). The manual does not say whether a co-candidate should also be listed as a partner, so the convention the coders mostly used (non-candidate partners only) is proposed.

note: Convention question for XL, also relevant to NCT05785754 and NCT06356883: should combination_partners list co-candidates or only non-candidate backbone and RT? The regimen_id difference (priority 3) is not adjudicated here. any_molecular_selection is true from the MGMT-unmethylated entry requirement. CED by catheter is coded as new_route, not device_dependent, by both coders.
